# Breathe Deep Dental

> A comprehensive dental practice in Bend, OR led by Dr. Sophie Diepenheim, specializing in preventive, restorative, and innovative airway-focused dentistry including sleep apnea treatment and TMJ therapy.

Breathe Deep Dental offers a full range of dental services from routine cleanings to advanced treatments like The Vivos System for sleep apnea and clear aligner orthodontics. The practice emphasizes patient-centric care and oral health education through a dedicated blog and patient resources.

## Core Services

- [Preventative Dentistry in Bend](https://www.breathedeepdental.com/service-categories/preventive-dentistry): Preventive dentistry services including cleanings, exams, and oral cancer screenings.
- [Restorative Dentistry in Bend](https://www.breathedeepdental.com/service-categories/restorative-dentistry): Restorative dentistry services: crowns, fillings, implants, bridges, and dentures.
- [Sleep Apnea Treatment in Bend](https://www.breathedeepdental.com/services/sleep-apnea-treatment): Sleep apnea treatment including The Vivos System for obstructive sleep apnea.
- [TMJ/TMD Therapy in Bend](https://www.breathedeepdental.com/services/tmj-tmd-therapy): TMJ/TMD therapy for jaw pain relief and teeth grinding treatment in Bend.
- [Emergency Dentistry Bend, OR](https://www.breathedeepdental.com/services/emergency-dentistry): Emergency dental care for urgent pain relief and tooth extraction.

## Cosmetic & Orthodontic Services

- [Clear Aligners in Bend](https://www.breathedeepdental.com/services/clear-aligners): Clear aligner orthodontic treatment with CandidPro for teeth straightening.
- [Veneers in Bend, OR](https://www.breathedeepdental.com/services/veneers): Cosmetic veneer services with porcelain and resin composite options.
- [Dental Crowns](https://www.breathedeepdental.com/services/dental-crowns): Dental crown restoration services using porcelain and ceramic materials.
- [Dentures in Bend, OR](https://www.breathedeepdental.com/services/dentures): Denture services for tooth replacement and oral health restoration.
- [Xeomin in Bend, OR](https://www.breathedeepdental.com/services/xeomin): Xeomin neurotoxin treatment for TMJ pain relief and facial rejuvenation.
